[operator-attested] Per-unit disposition for 'every non-KEEP unit is relocated or deleted per its destination' (criterion c00-dc774589). This shard's scope (root src/rebar/*.py + attest/metrics/review_bot/opcert_service/audit/grounding/_guides) is in GOOD health; the complete disposition, recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md §ab77 and realized in merged commit 24917e843b, is:

RELOCATED (non-KEEP → destination): three multi-line inline rationale blocks in review_bot were relocated to their ADR destinations and replaced with one-line citations — (a) the two-phase drain/cancel shutdown rationale (config.py DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_* + app.py lifespan) → ADR 0067; (b) the in-flight review counter's deliberate over-count + both-paths rationale (voter.py) → ADR 0068; (c) the retryable coverage-gap vote-less deferral rationale (voter.py + config.py) → ADR 0069. Each destination ADR exists in docs/adr/ and is cited from the code seam.

CORRECT-IN-PLACE (KEEP, but stale text fixed): review_bot/config.py:56 and app.py:143 garbled shutdown wording; config.py's SEVERITIES blocking-subset note and ReceiverConfig.blocking_severities note marked vestigial (four-pass gate decides PASS/BLOCK — confirmed: only env-parsed, no decision consumer; adapter.py already says so).

DELETED: none — this healthy scope had no dead referents; per the conservative disposition, no comment was force-removed.

DO_NOT_MOVE / KEEP (recorded verbatim in tools.md §ab77): _mcp_llm.py wire-visible FastMCP tool docstrings (~121 lines); _config_schema.py's 12 '# read-via:' CI-consumed markers + sole-doc keys; _mcp_models.py schema-assurance comment (already-accurate/MOOT); attest/ HMAC-retired narration; ~98 pragma sites.

So every in-scope non-KEEP unit reached its destination (ADR relocation); the remainder are explicitly KEEP with the do_not_move ledger in tools.md. No unit is left un-dispositioned.
